children: XPO reported preliminary August LTL tonnage growth of 3.7% and finalized July tonnage up 5.8% year‑over‑year.
July 2026 final North American LTL tonnage per day rose 5.8% vs July 2025.
July increase driven by shipments per day up 5.9% while weight per shipment fell 0.2%.
Preliminary August 2026 LTL tonnage per day increased 3.7% vs August 2025.
August rise attributed to shipments per day up 5.7% and weight per shipment down 1.8%; results are preliminary.
